posts.text: New heat pump, hot water cylinder and low loss header conversion from the old electric ecostor system.
We are currently looking for a plumber to join our busy team. Fancy a change in the new year. With excellent rates of pay. In box me if you are interested or call me on 07781122085.
Heat pump installs and servicing.

Just a few projects completed lately.
From oil boilers, electric, heat pump's, maintenance on existing systems of all types. Solar and renewable energy to new builds and tap washers.
Oil to electric conversion and all the plant moved from the basement to an external storage room.
Vented of mains water pressure conversion.
Two new heat pumps up and running before Christmas. Customer said the house has never been so warm. In association with Duquemin & Ozanne (CI) Ltd.
We can install water stop valve's for insurance purposes or just peace of mind.
New pair of cylinders going in. Heat pumps and solar to follow.
New boiler, cylinder, auxiliaries and pipework install.
Client needed more hot water so with this additional 500 liters coupled with the current 300 they have more than enough now.
More heat pump's going in.
A few heat pumps and bathroom's we completed at the end of the year. Thanks to all over 2021 and look forward to seeing you i  2022. Happy Christmas.

We fit alot of renewable energy here in Guernsey and are now proud to be doing our bit by upgrading our fleet to electric vehicles. We will gradually phase out our old diesels and support Guernsey's aim to be carbon neutral.
Please feel free to get in touch for all your renewable and plumbing needs. See less
This new system has nearly all the renewable energy on it you can get.
More heat pumps going in.
We're still here for genuine emergency call out's. With all precautions taken.

Due to the recent developments we will only be responding to genuine emergency call outs at this time as outlined by the S.O.G.
Please call 07781 122085.
Thank you.
New heat pump ready for Christmas.

Lot's of cylinder servicing going on today. 5 today and 9 booked in for tomorrow. Remember your pressurised cylinder needs to be serviced once a year for the warranty and sometimes your house insurance may require it also.
If you need one serviced give us a call. See less
New lease of life for this boosted hot and cold water pump set to improve the pressure of the water system. With the new control head's fitted.
New oil boiler, flu, and full re pipe of the plant room with associated controls. All flushed and tested.

After reading the rule's on the SOG website about essential working we will continue to adhere to the #stayathome as it quiet clearly says "UNLESS" it is for an emergency purposes only, in which case call 07781122085 for all genuine emergencies.
We will not be charging more than our usual rate for out of hours call outs or daytime response.
Stay safe,
Paul. See less
We are still available for genuine call out's. Please call 07781 122085.
We are closed now until the 6th of January. Thank you to everyone's custom in 2019 and look forward to seeing you again soon in 2020.
Nice compact boosted cold water set up.
Just a couple of the oil to electric conversions being installed.
Remember to get your water filters changed every 6-12 months.

Another heat pump and associated controls and hot water system put in. Full house re-plumb and under floor heating that works perfectly with the new heat pump. Also with two new bathrooms aswell. See less

New retro fit wet underfloor heating system that can be used in new builds too. Its minimal thickness means it can be applied without the need to riase floor heights more than carpet thickness. It also has high insulation properties because of the tile like board it is made from.
According to the manufacturer's this is one of the best installs they have ever seen and is now using these pictures of a prime example of how to lay it correctly.
So give us a call if your interested. See less

Dont forget that it is important to check your magnetic filters on your heating system. If you dont have one installed it may be worth looking into and giving us a call.
A magnetic filter stops any metal deposits getting back to the boiler and causing possible problems like leaks and sludge build up. See less
They dont make copper like they used too!
Two old heat pumps being removed to make way for a new heating source to be installed.
Another mains water pressurised hot water cylinder with balanced cold all heated by two solar panels on the roof. All supplied and fitted by ourselves.

Here are a just a few of our air source heat pump projects comming to an end. We also carry out conventional oil boiler changes, oil storage tanks, hot water cylinder changes and electric boilers. See less
Nice bit of old school plumbing.
Nice little plant room all ready for lagging.

Thanks for everyone's support in 2018. we re-open on the 2nd of January.
Merry Christmas.
Magnetic filter hard at work on a full system flush. To make sure your heating is working to its full potential and maximum efficiency give us a call.
Just serviced and looks like new, ready for winter.
